title: @eddiehinkle Great job on the show. One thing we missed was the multiple identities and talking about how that "was more common." I think it still is
summary: @eddiehinkle Great job on the show. One thing we missed was the multiple identities and talking about how that "was more common." I think it still is but we are old now and not trying on as many new skins as a teenager exploring identities online.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @eddiehinkle Great job on the show. One thing we missed was the multiple identities and talking about how that "was more common." I think it still is but we are old now and not trying on as many new skins as a teenager exploring identities online.
